examples.question: show me all table names in the database
examples.sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name;
examples.explanation: Use information_schema.tables with table_name column (not tablename)

examples.question: show products with low inventory
examples.sql:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.sku, i.quantity_on_hand, i.reorder_point
                         FROM products p
                         JOIN inventory i ON i.product_id = p.id
                         WHERE i.quantity_on_hand < i.reorder_point
                         ORDER BY i.quantity_on_hand ASC;
examples.explanation: Join products and inventory tables, compare quantity_on_hand with reorder_point
